status: RATIFIED and WIRED — day.ts's soulWeight() reads workplace_screens/time_blocks as a placement weight bonus for every role. Blacksmith and Baker's rows were additionally hardened into an unconditional placement for the souls dealt those roles this slice (Soul.fixed_placement, 2026-08-31) — see each row's own note.
note: Architect proposal: plausible workplace fits grounded in the layout draft's screens. Screen names are placeholder flavor, so every fit is provisional by construction; rows with 'uncertain: true' have a structural doubt beyond flavor. Capacity and who actually stands where remain the permutation resolver's output — this table only proposes each role's home base. `goal` (D7, gdd/07-cast.md's role pool table) and `goal_threads` (D7, src/roleGoals.ts) added 2026-08-01: goal_threads lists only the thread_id(s) a real authored scene's state_actions actually moves for a soul dealt that role — an empty list is a real content gap, never a guess.

roles.goal_threads_note: Filled 2026-08-24 (T9, festival scoring). `ilsa-forge-short` is v01's licensed want × role-goal tension row for the soul dealt Blacksmith this life — its own thread doc states it in the `toby-feast-short` form ("role-goal: forge the Lantern Arch centerpiece"), and v01's authored ink really does call `recordThreadMove("ilsa-forge-short")`. F1 keeps its bonus for evening's ordinary draw, but nothing of hers is authored there any more; a soul standing there is now a plain, scene-less presence.
